query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Build a recurring job-search digest by finding relevant LinkedIn job listings and sending the result or status update via Gmail.
query_ground_truth.query: find recent LinkedIn job listings for job search digest

requirement_groups.purpose: search for web pages containing LinkedIn job listings

query_ground_truth.rationale: Finding job listings on LinkedIn requires a web search capability to surface relevant external pages.

results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Draft several distinct, narrow queries for COMPOSIO_SEARCH_WEB (role/skills + location/region + work arrangement + seniority + freshness terms; optionally add source qualifiers).

[Required] [Step]: For each query, call COMPOSIO_SEARCH_WEB and capture leads from results.citations first (title/snippet/url), using other URL-like fields only if citations are empty; ignore narrative answer when it conflicts.
[Optional (if a next-page token is present)] [Next Step]: Continue paging with COMPOSIO_SEARCH_WEB up to a small cap, aggregating across queries while tracking duplicates.
[Required] [Next Step]: Canonicalize and deduplicate URLs across pages/queries; keep the best snippet and strongest freshness/location hints per canonical URL.

[Required] [Next Step]: Enrich shortlisted leads with COMPOSIO_SEARCH_FETCH_URL_CONTENT (cap with max_characters) and parse data.results[] (and data.statuses[] if present) to extract role, location/remote, requirements, compensation (if stated), and apply link.

[Required] [Step]: Filter out non-posting pages, then rank by match quality and explicit freshness evidence found in snippets or fetched text; return a concise list of links with extracted highlights (leave missing fields as unknown).

[Required] [Fallback]: If results are sparse or aggregator-heavy, use COMPOSIO_SEARCH_NEWS or COMPOSIO_SEARCH_TRENDS to refine keywords/query wording (or relax over-strict terms), then rerun COMPOSIO_SEARCH_WEB and re-validate via COMPOSIO_SEARCH_FETCH_URL_CONTENT.
known_pitfalls: [COMPOSIO_SEARCH_WEB] HTTP 429 can occur on heavy or near-duplicate queries; batch distinct searches and use exponential backoff.
[COMPOSIO_SEARCH_WEB] results.answer/data.answer may be generic or contradict results.citations; treat citations as the primary source of actionable links.
[COMPOSIO_SEARCH_WEB] results.citations field shapes vary (snippet/metadata often missing); null-check when extracting and ranking.
[COMPOSIO_SEARCH_WEB] “Invalid request data provided… missing {'query'}” occurs if the query field is absent/misnamed or empty.

[COMPOSIO_SEARCH_FETCH_URL_CONTENT] Content is typically under data.results[] (sometimes paired with data.statuses[]) and may be truncated by max_characters; refetch with a higher cap or treat missing sections as unknown.

COMPOSIO_SEARCH_WEB.description: Perform a web search using the Exa API. Returns a nested structure: narrative summary under results.answer, sources under results.citations (and optionally results.organic_results). Prioritize results.citations as primary evidence over results.answer, which can be vague. Only indexes publicly available content — no paywalled, login-gated, or private content. No date filters enforced; include recency terms in query and verify dates in snippets manually. Throttle to ~1–2 requests/second; bursty queries trigger HTTP 429. Large responses may be stored remotely — use structure_info to locate results.answer and results.citations.

query.description: The search query for the Composio Exa API. Must be non-empty; using any other parameter name (e.g., 'q') causes an invalid-request error. Include qualifiers (year, region, platform, intent) for better results — broad queries return generic content; excessive site: or quoted-term filters can return zero results. Add disambiguating terms (city, role, domain) when searching for people or organizations with common names.

COMPOSIO_SEARCH_FETCH_URL_CONTENT.description: Fetch and extract clean, readable page text (markdown) from public web pages (HTML content) using the Exa API. Use when you need to retrieve actual content from search results or documentation links to extract setup steps, requirements, or citations. Only works with web page URLs - does not support direct links to images, PDFs, or other binary files.

text.description: Include extracted markdown text content from the page. Defaults to true.

urls.description: List of public URLs to web pages (HTML content) to fetch content from. URLs must be valid and publicly accessible. Do not use direct links to images (.jpg, .png, .gif), PDFs, or other binary files - use web page URLs only. Also accepts a single URL string.

extras.description: Additional content options like imageLinks or links counts (e.g., {'imageLinks': 3, 'links': 5}).

summary.description: Include AI-generated summary of the page content. Can be boolean or object with query/schema options.

max_characters.description: Maximum number of characters to extract from each page. Maps to text.maxCharacters in Exa API.

COMPOSIO_SEARCH_NEWS.description: Search for the latest news articles and current events with smart filtering. Searches news-oriented sources only (not blogs, docs, or company pages). Results nest under `data.results.news_results`; a 200 response with empty `news_results` or `news_results_state: 'Fully empty'` means no results — broaden query or `when` window. Auto-correction (`showing_results_for`) can silently redirect queries; verify returned articles match intended topic. Only first page returned by default; follow `pagination.next` for more pages. Supports 100+ languages and countries. Use advanced operators like 'site:' for publisher filtering directly in your query. Examples: query="artificial intelligence" + when="w" for past week's AI news query="climate change" + gl="us" + hl="en" for US climate news query="business news" + when="d" for today's business news query="site:bbc.com tesla" + when="d" for today's BBC Tesla news

gl.description: Country code for news region (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Determines which country's news sources to prioritize.

hl.description: Language code for news interface and results. Most languages use ISO 639-1 codes (e.g., 'en', 'es'). Chinese requires regional variants: 'zh-cn' (Simplified) or 'zh-tw' (Traditional). Standalone 'zh' is normalized to 'zh-cn'.

when.description: Time filter for news articles. 'd' = past day, 'w' = past week, 'm' = past month, 'y' = past year. These are coarse UTC-based buckets with no finer granularity; filter `published_at` client-side for precise ranges. Combining narrow queries with strict `when` filters frequently returns zero results; broaden either before concluding no data exists.

query.description: Search query for news articles. Supports advanced operators like 'site:', 'when:', etc. Cannot be used with topic_token, publication_token, or story_token.

start.description: Result offset for pagination. Each page typically contains 10 results. Use multiples of 10 (0, 10, 20, 30, ...) to navigate pages. Stop paginating when a page returns no new results.
